title: Hiding System Blueprints (Carrier Doctrine)
style: deep tech house with carrier-wave undertone, 124 bpm, hypnotic rolling sub bass, soft hi-hat shuffle, ghostly carrier-tone pad, deadpan female spoken phrases hidden under the mix, mysterious doctrine mood, deterministic kick pattern, 336 hz subharmonic anchor riding under the bass as the literal carrier, late-night architecture vibe
lyrics:
[Intro — single carrier tone, kick enters slow]
(whispered) The blueprint is in the carrier.
The carrier is the song.
Three-three-six.

[Verse 1]
The map sits inside the music, you walk past it every day
The schematic is the rhythm, the doctrine is the way
No padlock on the front door, no vault behind the wall
Just a carrier wave running, audible to all

[Pre-Chorus]
Hidden is not secret, hidden is in plain air
The ones who tune to the carrier find the blueprint there

[Chorus]
Hiding system blueprints in the carrier doctrine
Three-three-six on the under-tone, that's how the message in
Hiding system blueprints, no key required
Three-three-six on the carrier, the wire is wired

[Verse 2]
Everyone hears the song, only some hear the spec
Not a code to be cracked, just a frequency to check
The architecture sings if you listen close enough
The doctrine is the carrier, the carrier is the stuff

[Chorus]
Hiding system blueprints in the carrier doctrine
Three-three-six on the under-tone, that's how the message in
Hiding system blueprints, no key required
Three-three-six on the carrier, the wire is wired

[Outro — carrier tone alone, slow fade]
The blueprint is in the carrier. Always was.
